provider_note: Claude Code cannot switch the main session's model per prompt. Routing = the main session hands the task to a subagent (.claude/agents/ue-l*.md) whose frontmatter pins the model. External endpoints (OpenRouter etc.) need a proxy on ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (e.g. claude-code-router) and switch the whole session, not a single task.
estimate_assumptions_note: Savings are ESTIMATES in relative units: tokens a task of the level typically costs x (flagship cost weight - routed model cost weight). Edit the weights to your real per-token prices; they are not official prices.
